messages:
elle-support: Heads-up — customer AcmeHealth seeing a spike in structured-output (JSON mode) parse failures after last deploy. ~8% of calls return 422 / INVALID_JSON and they're getting billed for retries. Logs are redacted so we can't see the original payload. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Can ops/devex help triage?

observability-bot: [ALERT] json_mode_parse_rate > 5% for model=gpt-open-x in prod-us-east (2026-11-15T14:02Z).

samir-ml: Can you paste the request_id(s) and a sample request body (if available)? Also which SDK/version is the customer on?

elle-support: request_id: req_0a1b2c3d, req_0f9e8d7c. Customer says they POST user content — their integration sometimes includes trailing commas. Logs only show redacted_user_text, e.g.:

```json
{
  "prompt": "<REDACTED_USER_TEXT>",
  "mode": "json",
  "schema_version": "v2",
}
```

They report the SDK retrying on parse errors which increases cost.

raj-sre: If logs are redacted we should capture a small sampled copy of full inputs for debugging. Suggest setting `structured_output_full_sample_rate=0.001` for the tenant for 1h (0.1%) and emit a counter metric `redwood_json_parse_failures{tenant="acmehealth"}` with request_id tag. Also attach trace span `json_parser` with the request_id.

hannah-devex: Agree on sampling. From dashboard POV we need: 1) parse_failure_rate over time, 2) sampled_full_inputs count vs sample_rate, 3) latency P50/P95 for parse errors. Alert proposal: parse_failure_rate > 3% for 10m => paging to oncall. Add a non-paging warning at 1%.

elle-support: Repro steps from the customer: curl POST /v1/generate with body similar to above. They send from a lambda (node 18) using redwood-sdk@1.4.2. They see response body sometimes containing `{"error":"invalid json"}` then client retries.

samir-ml: Quick local repro I used — start runtime with `MODEL=gpt-open-x JSON_MODE=1` and send malformed JSON (trailing comma). Parser throws but error surface currently is opaque (we return generic 422). I'll add a local unit test and a small fix to error message to include `error_code: INVALID_JSON_TRUNCATED` when applicable.

raj-sre: Short-term mitigation: I deployed a fallback that returns structured text mode for opt-in tenants when parse fails, to avoid cascading retries and double billing. Rollout note: enabled for acmehealth only, will monitor for 30m then expand. I also bumped logging sample rate for the tenant. Logged rollout in #eng-releases.

elle-support: Thanks — I notified the customer about the fallback. Filing internal ticket with repro and request ids: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SD-1729

observability-bot: Ticket SD-1729 created by elle-support.

hannah-devex: I'll own the dashboard + runbook (include steps to capture sampled inputs, how to flip fallback, and SLA messaging). Will link dashboard within 60m.

elle-support: Assigning follow-up: samir-ml for parser error granularity, raj-sre for metrics/trace emission, hannah-devex for dashboard/runbook. Keep updates here.

samir-ml: On it — will push a patch and a small test.

raj-sre: Will add `redwood_json_parse_failures` metric and a 0.1% retention of full inputs for 1h, then purge.

elle-support: 👍 closing thread for now, will reopen if customer still sees errors after sampling window.
